name: US equity stress
summary: VIX closed at 25.5 on 17 Nov and the S&P 500 sits 6.1% below its high, inside both Watch bands
state: The VIX closed near 25.5 on 17 Nov, up 46% on the week and above the 20 Watch line (Yahoo Finance). The S&P 500 ended near 7,341, 6.1% below its 52-week high of 7,819 and 3.7% lower on the week; its worst day of the past five sessions was a 1.9% fall. No VIX close above 30 or circuit breaker was recorded.
for_you: Large swings in US shares tend to show up in pension and fund valuations and can spread to other markets. This describes market conditions only.
rubric_hit: VIX 23.9 ≥ 20 Watch line; S&P drawdown 6.22% ≥ 5% Watch line
why: The S&P 500 is the world's risk barometer; sharp falls and spiking volatility transmit to pensions, credit and confidence globally.
drivers: Earnings, interest-rate expectations, liquidity, geopolitical shocks, positioning and leverage.

rubric.alert: VIX > 30, or drawdown > 15%, or a market-wide circuit breaker trips.
rubric.normal: VIX < 20 and S&P 500 drawdown from 52-week high < 5%.
